howItWorks.body: Your rate comes from what actually lands in your account. After tax and UIF, across the days you work, including the commute you never get paid for.

why.paragraph2: So I built this app. It helps you see your spending in a different way: not just in currency, but in hours of your life. Because sometimes <cost>"R120"</cost> doesn't feel like much, but <time>"2 hours of my life"</time> does. The goal is simple, to help you become more aware of where your money (or really, time) is going, so you can take back control of it.

home.title: Expense Tracker App for South Africa - Money2Time
home.description: See every rand as hours of your life. A private expense tracker that works out your hourly rate after tax and UIF, with no bank login.
home.openGraphDescription: Every rand you spend, priced in hours of your life. Track debit orders too — no bank login, nothing leaves your phone.
